verified_facts.text: Alila Wuzhen is set on the edge of a water town, surrounded by winding canals, wooden corridors and stone bridges.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set on the edge of a storied water town, Alila Wuzhen offers a contemporary retreat immersed in centuries of heritage. Surrounded by winding canals, wooden corridors and stone bridges

verified_facts.text: The resort is inspired by a classic Jiangnan village, reimagined with modern, minimalist architecture.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by a classic Jiagnan village—yet reimagined with modern, minimalist architecture

verified_facts.text: Water flows through the resort, forming a water courtyard and wrapping around the suites and villas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Water flows through Alila Wuzhen, forming an inviting water courtyard and wrapping around spacious suites and villas.

verified_facts.text: The resort's structures are situated around plantings of Metasequoia, an endangered native conifer.
verified_facts.excerpt: Its structures are carefully situated around plantings of Metasequoia, an endangered native conifer.

verified_facts.text: Accommodations include rooms and villas, such as the Garden Villa.
Spa Alila offers massages, facials and body scrubs, plus locally inspired treatments made with indigenous Wuzhen ingredients.
verified_facts.excerpt: Indulge in an extensive menu of treatments including relaxing massages, revitalizing facials and rejuvenating body scrubs, as well as locally inspired treatments made with indigenous Wuzhen ingredients.

verified_facts.text: The resort has heated indoor and outdoor pools with panoramic water views.
verified_facts.excerpt: heated indoor and outdoor pools connects you with the best of nature—and stunning panoramic water views

verified_facts.text: The 24-hour gym has dedicated yoga and meditation studios.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our 24-hour, high-end gym features dedicated yoga and meditation studios

verified_facts.text: Guests can join a hands-on indigo dyeing workshop, working with master artisans to craft their own dyed creation.
verified_facts.excerpt: This hands-on workshop introduces you to the ancient practice of indigo dyeing, long revered across the Jiangnan region.

verified_facts.text: A singing bowl sound journey combines a guided meditation with aromatherapy, and guests can play the bowls themselves.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests also get the chance to play the bowls themselves, allowing a personal connection to this mindful art to take hold.

verified_facts.text: A tea experience with the resort's Tea Master includes tasting teas and painting with powdered tea leaves.
verified_facts.excerpt: Begin with a warm welcome from our Tea Master and a short introduction to the history and meaning of tea in Chinese culture.

verified_facts.text: Si Shui serves local cuisine with seafood from local lakes and ingredients from the resort's own farm, with a view of the central water feature.
verified_facts.excerpt: Dine on exquisite local cuisine, with the freshest seafood from local lakes and ingredients from our very own farm.

verified_facts.text: The resort has an extensive whiskey collection.
verified_facts.excerpt: experience our extensive whiskey collection against sublime water tableaus

verified_facts.text: Wuzhen, in the Jiangnan region, is known as the 'Home of Silk' and is famed for its silk production.
verified_facts.excerpt: Also referred to as the “Home of Silk,” Wuzhen is famed for its silk production, and you can learn about sericulture and explore age-old fabric dyeing traditions.

verified_facts.text: Each guest room may accommodate up to two pet dogs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each guest room may accommodate up to two pet dogs.

verified_facts.text: The nearest listed airport is Hangzhou Xiaoshan International Airport, 82.4 kilometers away.
The hotel recommends local mapping apps such as Gaode Map or Baidu Map, as international mapping apps may not be accurate in Chinese Mainland.
verified_facts.excerpt: we recommend using local mapping applications such as Gaode Map or Baidu Map. International mapping apps may not be accurate in Chinese Mainland.

verified_facts.text: Free parking and electric vehicle charging are offered.
